% Files of the document read by an absolute path, each named like
% glossary.4ht, and each but one naming itself with \ProvidesFile: read
% with \input, with and without the extension, with the import package's
% \import and \subimport, with \InputIfFileExists, through an absolute
% folder in \input@path, by a path with "..", in the body, and with the
% subfiles package's \subfile. One names itself without the extension,
% with a date and a version, and one gives another file's name. As in the
% PDF, each file's text is in the page.
%
% Built as it is, \AbsDir is empty and every path is relative. run.mjs
% builds the page again once for each case, with a test-abspath-case.tex
% in TEXINPUTS that sets \AbsDir to the absolute path of test/fixtures/
% and \AbsCase to the case's name, so that only that case is read: a
% file marked as the document's would keep glossary.4ht from being read
% for the cases after it. (The config is read too late, at
% \begin{document}.) Each file gives its text with \absread, which adds
% whether the file was read by an absolute path.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{import}
\usepackage{subfiles}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\makeatletter
\InputIfFileExists{test-abspath-case}{}{\def\AbsDir{}}
% \abscase{<case>}{<code>}: the code, unless \AbsCase names another case
\newcommand\abscase[1]{%
  \def\abs@name{#1}%
  \ifdefined\AbsCase
    \ifx\abs@name\AbsCase\let\abs@next\@firstofone\else\let\abs@next\@gobble\fi
  \else
    \let\abs@next\@firstofone
  \fi
  \abs@next}
% (an absolute path when the current file's folder begins with /)
\newcommand\abskind{\expandafter\abs@kind\CurrentFilePathUsed\relax\abs@end}
\def\abs@kind#1#2\abs@end{\if/#1an absolute\else a relative\fi}
% (global, as \subfile reads its file in a group)
\newcommand\absread[2]{\expandafter\xdef\csname abs#1\endcsname{#2 By \abskind\space path.}}
\abscase{input}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/input/glossary}}
\abscase{ext}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/ext/glossary.tex}}
\abscase{import}{\import{\AbsDir test-abspath/import/}{glossary}}
\abscase{subimport}{\subimport{\AbsDir test-abspath/subimport/}{glossary}}
\abscase{ifexists}{\InputIfFileExists{\AbsDir test-abspath/ifexists/glossary}{}{}}
\abscase{path}{%
  \edef\input@path{{\AbsDir test-abspath/path/}}%
  \input{provd}%
  \let\input@path\@undefined}
\abscase{dots}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/input/../dots/glossary}}
\abscase{option}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/option/glossary}}
\abscase{defs}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/defs/defs}}
\abscase{plain}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/plain/glossary}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\abscase{input}{Input: \absinput\par}
\abscase{ext}{Extension: \absext\par}
\abscase{import}{Import: \absimport\par}
\abscase{subimport}{Subimport: \abssubimport\par}
\abscase{ifexists}{If exists: \absifexists\par}
\abscase{path}{Path: \abspath\par}
\abscase{dots}{Dots: \absdots\par}
\abscase{option}{Option: \absoption\par}
\abscase{defs}{Other name: \absdefs\par}
\abscase{plain}{Unnamed: \absplain\par}
\abscase{body}{\input{\AbsDir test-abspath/body/glossary}Body: \absbody\par}
\abscase{subfile}{\subfile{\AbsDir test-abspath/subfile/glossary}Subfile: \abssubfile\par}
\end{document}
